name: Consent_State
doc: The states for each consent at the most recently available point in time

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: The user_id to which the consent applies

fields.name: legal_entity_id
fields.doc: The legal entity for which the user gave consent to

fields.name: purpose_id
fields.doc: A purpose_id identifies a legal basis for the consent, and restricts the usage of the requested information to the user only for those scenarios covered under the purpose definition

fields.name: identifier
fields.doc: The scope of a consent can be restricted to a specific identifier that the user has (e.g. just on of his cell phone numbers). If this field is null then the consent applies to all possible identifiers

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The status of the consent. The only status that allows accessing the user's information is "Active"

fields.name: creation_date
fields.doc: The creation date of the consent

fields.name: expiration_date
fields.doc: The expiration date of the consent. Consents that do not expire will have a null value in this field

fields.name: user_prompted
fields.doc: The date of the consent last time that the consent request was shown to the user. If the consent request has never been shown to the user, then null

fields.name: BRAND_ID
fields.doc: Commercial brand identifier. In order to differentiate among different brands in the same OB (e.g. Movistar, O2, Tuenti...)

fields.name: TRIGGERED_BY_DES
fields.doc: Name of the process that launched the creation of a consent

fields.name: DELEGATED_IND
fields.doc: Flag indicator to mark if the consent has been delegated to a third party

fields.name: KERNEL_APP_ID
fields.doc: App ID identifier, refering to the client id used when performing an OAuth flow
